observations.identity: The amber eyes, warm-brown bob, facial proportions, bangs, and gentle expression closely match the accepted Akari v1.2 face reference.
observations.age: The face remains softly youthful while the body proportions and calm presentation retain the intended adult 25-year-old impression.
observations.overhead_read: The rug geometry, hair spread, foreshortening, and aligned body produce an immediate true overhead read near the requested 90-degree camera.
observations.anatomy: Head, shoulders, arms, hands, torso, pelvis, legs, and socked feet form a complete connected figure without extra or fused anatomy.
observations.ornament_side: The complete pale-blue crossed-pin and ribbon ornament remains on character-left, appearing on image-right in this face-up orientation.
observations.outfit: The oversized white hoodie, visible modest pale-gray shorts, and two-stripe socks are cleanly constructed and readable.
observations.intimacy: The direct gaze and one hand resting over the chest communicate quiet emotional closeness without sexualized framing or body emphasis.
observations.composition: The nearly vertical figure is fully contained, occupies the intended share of the frame, and is balanced by ivory-rug negative space and one pale-blue cushion.
observations.artifacts: No readable text, branding, watermark, panel border, malformed fingers, clipped feet, or visible generation defect is present.
observations.collection_role: The stable pose, strongest identity match, restrained palette, direct gaze, and clear top-down read make this the stronger reusable collection anchor.

candidates.decision_reason: Recommended as the anchor because it has the clearest true-overhead read, closest face identity, strongest direct intimacy, and most stable full-body composition.
